question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM veg_loss_rate_df WHERE "loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss - s.stddev_loss) AS below_one_stddev,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM veg_loss_rate_df WHERE "loss_rate_%" BETWEEN s.avg_loss - s.stddev_loss AND s.avg_loss + s.stddev_loss) AS within_one_stddev,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM veg_loss_rate_df WHERE "loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss + s.stddev_loss) AS above_one_stddev
    FROM stats s
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(s.avg_loss, 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(s.stddev_loss, 2) AS std_dev_loss_rate,
    c.below_one_stddev,
    c.within_one_stddev,
    c.above_one_stddev
FROM stats s
CROSS JOIN counts c
